To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Hyperband-Dijkstra is a new workflow that efficiently combines deep learning neural networks to generate accurate and efficient ensembles.

Hyperband-Dijkstra: (1) improves the accuracy of deep learning ensembles by up to 10% on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, (2) is 2-4x faster to generate an ensemble of the same size than state of the art ensembles, and (3) is the first to automatically design ensembles of deep neural networks.

Hyperband-Dijkstra is the first workflow that combines Hyperband with Dijkstra to efficiently explore neural networks with Hyperband and combine them with Dijkstra, and it is the first workflow to recycle sub-optimial solutions to generate efficient ensembles.
